subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should `/status`, the TUI status summary, and the TUI footer prefer persisted session `label`/`displayName` over raw session keys, and what fallback order should be canonical?
rationale: The metadata already exists and Control UI uses it, but changing CLI/TUI status display semantics affects user-visible operator output and should settle fallback, sanitization, and raw-key detail behavior before implementation.

options.title: Adopt shared friendly-label display
options.body: Add `label`/`displayName` to the shared status summary and render label-first output across CLI/TUI with sanitized raw-key fallback.

options.title: Keep only Control UI fixed
options.body: Declare CLI/TUI status key-first output intentional and close this issue as not planned while leaving #85688 for structured attribution.

options.title: Defer to broader attribution design
options.body: Move this request under #85688 and solve labels only as part of a wider stable status/usage attribution contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared friendly-label display
recommendation.body: Add `label`/`displayName` to the shared status summary and render label-first output across CLI/TUI with sanitized raw-key fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent merged history on the shared status and TUI status paths most directly affected by the display decision.
